notes: Simulation: a grid-based incremental where placed mushrooms generate spores per second and each purchase raises the next cost — the number going up is the game. plot-isolated because the map is eight equally spaced claimable plots, each holding one player's 8x8 grid and billboard, arranged around the small central hub the answer chose over a single row. board-grid was rejected even though the grid is acted on rather than walked over: the plots are 32-stud grids of 4x4x4 blocks with avatars, billboards and walkable grass between them, so people do move through the build and the SET route would be wrong. Sandbox keeps its shape and options — collectible-nodes is the mushrooms the loop is built on and popped for spores, social-hub is the shared central hub, trigger-task is the grid tiles that mushrooms are placed onto — and path-circulation was left off because the answer says the space between plots is plain walkable grass with no added structures; the eight-plot count and the per-plot name-and-avatar billboard are recorded here since the schema cannot carry them.
